title: Sum of Natural Numbers
description: Sum numbers from 1 to N using loops and formulas, compare approaches, and sum even/odd numbers separately.

steps.title: Sum with a loop
steps.description: Write a `sumToN` function that uses a `for` loop to sum all numbers from 1 to N.
hints: Loop from 1 to N, adding each number to sum

codeTemplate.python:
def sumToN(n):
  sum = 0
  
  return sum

print(sumToN(5))
print(sumToN(10))

verification.failureMessage: sumToN(5) should return 15, sumToN(10) should return 55.

steps.title: Sum with formula
steps.description: Write a `sumToNFormula` function that uses the formula `n * (n + 1) / 2` instead of a loop.
hints: This is much faster for large N

steps.title: Compare methods
steps.description: Write a function that compares the loop and formula methods to verify they give the same result.
hints: Return true if they match, false otherwise

verification.successMessage: Both methods agree for all test values!
verification.failureMessage: compareMethods should return true when both methods give the same result.

steps.title: Sum of even numbers
steps.description: Write a `sumEvenToN` function that sums only the even numbers from 1 to N.
hints: Check if each number is even with n % 2 === 0
Add only the even numbers to the sum

steps.title: Sum of odd numbers
steps.description: Write a `sumOddToN` function that sums only the odd numbers from 1 to N.
hints: Use the same pattern as sumEvenToN
Check if a number is odd with n % 2 !== 0
Add only the odd numbers to the sum
